title: The 'Whose Ground' land-ownership decision (the Fallows) closed permanently on the very first backing choice I made in dialogue, with no side-by-side view of what each of the four claimants (Crown surveyor, Free Companies recruiter, Keeper, or the returners) was actually offering — there was no way to see who 'paid best' before committing, only after.
